newsitem.title: USA: ProxyMed signs pact for ProxyCare.
newsitem.headline: ProxyMed signs pact for ProxyCare.

text.p: ProxyMed Inc said on Thursday it signed an exclusive marketing agreement with Managed Healthcare Associates for its ProxyCare product.
ProxyCare automates communication between the nursing homes and pharmacy providers.

Under the terms of the deal, Managed Healthcare will market the ProxyCare system to about 750 institutional pharmacy members. The pharmacies service about 1.2 million of the 1.7 million nursing home beds in the U.S., ProxyMed said. It did not list financial terms.
